cohort.missingness_handling: Zero-masking with explicit modal indicator and attention dropout (p=0.3)

protocol.evaluation: Paired out-of-fold predictions averaged across 3 repeats (15 models per approach)

model_a_control.name: Clinical + FreeSurfer FS29 Compact Attention (No MRI)

model_b_experimental.name: Clinical + FreeSurfer FS29 + Baseline 3D MRI Compact Attention

paired_statistical_test.interpretation: The addition of raw whole-volume 3D MRI via 3D CNN and cross-modal attention yielded a nominal gain of +0.0070 in AUROC, which is not statistically significant (p = 0.2860, 95% CI crosses zero).
